Investor relations

The autonomous business platform for founders.

SIXXAB AI gives a founder a full executive team of AI agents that plans, sells, markets and runs the business, with a person approving anything that reaches a customer or spends money.

Why it matters

Small businesses can't afford the team they need.

Problem

Founders run everything alone

Strategy, marketing, sales and finance compete for one person's time, and consultants and agencies cost more than an early business earns.

Solution

An AI team that earns trust

Founder, executive and department agents work to one plan. Each task type earns more autonomy only after people approve its work.

Why now

Agents can finally do the work

Current AI models can draft, decide and act through real tools. What has been missing is the guardrails, approvals and learning loop to run a business on them.

What's built

Live at sixxab.ai, onboarding its first businesses.

  • Launched November 2026, with email and mobile sign-in and an installable app
  • Three pilot businesses in the US and India, including an orthopaedic hospital and a pathology lab
  • 21-step journey from first idea to a running business, stage by stage
  • Approved LinkedIn posts, comment replies and emails already go out live
  • Human approval enforced in the database, not left to the AI
  • Autonomy earned per task type, and every action audited
  • Model cost tracked per business and per agent
  • Revenue milestones from a $10K month to a $10M month, tracked and celebrated

Business model

Subscriptions, plus a partner channel.

Businesses subscribe on 12-month plans that start at $5,000 a month for startups and small businesses. Certified consultants license the platform to deliver SIXXAB to clients in their own countries, starting with the US and India.

Markets

United States and India

Launching in both, with USD and INR pricing, and a consultant network for expansion into new countries.

Founder

Sunil Kattikar

25 years in enterprise technology. Former Head of Cloud, AI & Platform Engineering at GameStop. Led a hybrid cloud modernization at Western Union with 35+ architects and engineers, after 17 years in transformation consulting at Infosys. Executive MBA; AWS and Azure certified solutions architect.

Built with

AI-native from day one

The platform is built and run with the same agent loop it sells: plan, act, approve, measure, learn and improve.
